title: Jyotish: What Astrology Actually Is
sub: Foundational notes on this 2015 talk by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life: what Jyotish means, why destiny is fixed yet never repeats, karma versus fate, planet by planet effects, and the three remedies.
desc: Complete notes on this 2015 talk, Jyotish, by Brajesh Gautam: what astrology actually is, the third eye, karma versus destiny, the Bhrigu Samhita, planet by planet effects, and daan, dua and dava, with video timestamps.
points: Science asks why something happened. Jyotish reads what is about to happen next, built on exact planetary math.
The sky is fixed, yet nothing repeats.
Every planet holds its own fixed path, but the Sun's 25,920-year loop never returns to the exact same point twice.
You get full freedom inside an allowed range: the sadhu's parable of lifting one leg, never both.
Karma and destiny are separate ledgers.
What you do and what lands on you can be unrelated, and knowing the future already changes how it lands.
Charity moves a planet through your own hand, prayer draws blessings, medicine cares for the body. None replaces the other two.
Ego keeps the third eye shut.
Drop grabbing, jealousy and attachment and the inner light turns on gradually, on its own schedule.
A mostly-right track record still gets called fake.
One missed prediction gets remembered far louder than fifty correct ones, the speaker's own complaint about his trade.
